SELECT notification_id AS notificationId, user_id AS userId, type_code AS typeCode, content AS content, is_read AS isRead, created_at AS createdAt, target_type AS targetType, target_id AS targetId, CASE WHEN type_code = 'SYSTEM_NOTICE' THEN 'system' WHEN type_code IN ('BOT_MESSAGE', 'CHAT_REMINDER') THEN 'mate' ELSE 'update' END AS type, CASE WHEN type_code = 'SUPPORT_ANSWER' AND LOCATE('
', content) > 0 THEN TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(content, '
', 1)) WHEN type_code = 'SUPPORT_ANSWER' THEN '신고/문의 답변이 등록되었습니다' WHEN type_code = 'POST_COMMENT' THEN '새 댓글이 달렸습니다' WHEN type_code = 'COMMENT_REPLY' THEN '대댓글이 달렸습니다' WHEN type_code = 'BOT_MESSAGE' THEN '메이티의 새 쪽지가 도착했습니다' WHEN type_code = 'SYSTEM_NOTICE' THEN '공지사항이 있습니다' WHEN type_code = 'POINT_REWARD' THEN '포인트가 지급되었습니다' WHEN type_code = 'COMMUNITY_HOT' THEN '내 글이 인기글이 되었습니다' WHEN type_code = 'REPORT_RESULT' THEN '신고 처리 결과가 나왔습니다' WHEN type_code = 'CHAT_REMINDER' THEN '메이트가 기다리고 있어요' WHEN type_code = 'EVENT_NOTICE' THEN '새로운 이벤트가 시작되었습니다' ELSE '새로운 알림이 있습니다' END AS title, CASE WHEN type_code = 'SUPPORT_ANSWER' AND LOCATE('
', content) > 0 THEN TRIM(SUBSTRING(content, LOCATE('
', content) + 1)) ELSE content END AS message FROM NOTIFICATION WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE NOTIFICATION SET is_read = 1 WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_read = 0
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM NOTIFICATION WHERE notification_id = #{notificationId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO NOTIFICATION (user_id, type_code, content, target_type, target_id) VALUES (#{userId}, #{typeCode}, #{content}, #{targetType}, #{targetId})
